# GalloConta

> AI-powered computer vision tool that counts common cranes (Grus grus) from a photo. Built by
> [Entibo](https://entibo.es).

## App

- [GalloConta (Spanish)](https://galloconta.app/es): upload a photo of a crane flock and get an
  instant AI-powered count, adjust detection sensitivity, and give feedback on each prediction.
- [GalloConta (English)](https://galloconta.app/en): same app, English interface.

## Model

GalloConta Community runs on **GRULLA**, a YOLOv11 model fine-tuned on a hand-annotated dataset of
crane flock photos. See the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rminguell/galloconta) for the
full model card, training details, and metrics (93.6% precision / 0.89 mAP50 on the test set).

## Citizen science

- [lab.galloconta.app](https://lab.galloconta.app): donate crane photos, help annotate images in
  CVAT, or join as a volunteer to help grow the training dataset — no prior experience needed.

## Source code

- [github.com/rminguell/galloconta](https://github.com/rminguell/galloconta): open-source backend
  (FastAPI + YOLOv11) and frontend (Next.js). Self-hostable — see the README for configuration.
